goal: Prevent outbound SOCKS5 Tor connections from failing on shortened IPv6 addresses with an inner "::"
Restores connectivity to up to 50% of reachable IPv6 peers for nodes routing through Tor proxies
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now; nothing is known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified by testing IPv6 peer selection over SOCKS proxy (andrewtoth)
Concept approval after confirming upstream Tor status (darosior)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes complete connection failures to many IPv6 peers over SOCKS5 Tor proxies
Tor exits misparse compressed addresses, dropping 20% to 50% of IPv6 destinations with no fallback
